_comment: Decrease-only accepted-debt ledger for container-query-gate.mjs. (a) deadContainerNames: @container <name> queries with no matching container-name declaration anywhere in src css -- a NEW dead name (not listed here) fails --check; revive a name by declaring container-name on some skin. (b) viewportQueries: per-file count of @media (max-width|min-width) declarations under presentation/components/** -- growth past a file's ceiling, or a NEW file with any count, fails --check; a file dropping below its ceiling is a tighten opportunity via --seed.

ds-table.reason: pre-existing at W6-A landing: patterns.css queries @container ds-table for the data-table column-priority-collapse rule, but no engine skin (checked runtime/engines/{modern,rustic}/skin/{table,data-table}.css) declares container-name: ds-table -- only a patterns.css comment claims it does. The rule has been silently inert since it landed. W6-A was told to keep ds-table as-is; this is disclosed debt for a follow-up, not something this lane fixes.

src/foundation/tokens/css/presentation/c.reason: RELOCATED 2026-08-02, not new debt: this is the same single query the patterns-paint.css entry below has always covered -- @media (max-width: 640px) { :is(.ds-command-home-console) { padding: 14px } } -- carried across when the orphaned paint half was migrated into patterns.css (see residual-adjudication.json itemZero). Shipped viewport-query debt is unchanged at 1, because patterns-paint.css is imported by no entrypoint and reaches no bundle; the duplicate below disappears when that tombstone is deleted. Still the pre-existing W6 "single" to audit individually in a later wave.

pre-existing viewport query outside the W6-A command-home migration scope (design doc W6 section 1.2 explicitly excludes this file as a "single" to audit individually in a later wave). Since 2026-08-02 this file is an unimported tombstone whose live twin is the patterns.css entry above; this entry retires with the file (whole-file RETIRE_PROPOSED).

ButtonGroup is itself the responsive flex container, so a self-referential container query cannot express its mobile posture without adding a wrapper to the public DOM contract. This single viewport query is accepted, decrease-only debt until responsive posture is supplied by a parent surface; aggregate viewport-query debt did not grow when oauth-transition migrated to a container query.
